sentences.text: By it, the respondent has been acquitted of the charge under Sections 376 (A) (B), 354 IPC and Section 3/4 and 9/10 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: A delay condonation application has been filed.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that soon after the receiving of copy of the judgment an opinion was formed that the appeal has to be preferred and in that process, the file was moved.
The delay condonation application gives the dates as to when the proposal was submitted for appeal and when the decision was taken.
Notices were issued on the respondent on the delay condonation application.

The notice was served,
but none is present for the respondent.
Having considered, there are good grounds to condone the delay.
Delay in filing the appeal is condoned.
In order to appreciate the arguments on admission, let call for the LCR.
